info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, loopX, loopWidth, cableGuy, distToGuy, tiltAngle, whaleState, snowBlow, slapCountglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gXVelChange, gScoreon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  whaleState = #WAITING  this.locZ = 203  cableGuy = sprite(6)  tiltAngle = 0  snowBlow = sprite(56)  slapCount = 1endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    prevXPos = Xpos    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    if (Xpos > 0) and (Xpos < 512) then      if (prevXPos <= 0) or (prevXPos >= 512) then        if soundBusy(2) = 0 then          puppetSound(2, member(74, "Sfx"))        end if      end if      case whaleState of        #WAITING:          spoutPoint = this.loc + point(-16, -93)          snowBlow.loc = spoutPoint          snowBlow.rotation = 180          xDiff = float(spoutPoint.locH - (cableGuy.locH + cableGuy.Xvel))          yDiff = float(spoutPoint.locV - (cableGuy.locV + cableGuy.Yvel))          if abs(xDiff) < 10 then            if (yDiff < 10) and (yDiff > -10) then              whaleState = #ROLL              tiltAngle = 360            end if          end if        #ROLL:          prevTiltAngle = tiltAngle          if tiltAngle > 0 then            tiltAngle = tiltAngle * 0.94999999999999996          end if          if (tiltAngle < 270) and (prevTiltAngle >= 270) then            if slapCount mod 2 then              puppetSound(4, member(11, "Sfx"))            else              puppetSound(4, member(75, "Sfx"))            end if            cableGuy.Xvel = -50            slapCount = slapCount + 1            gScore = gScore + 500          end if          if tiltAngle < 2 then            tiltAngle = 0            whaleState = #WAITING            if soundBusy(2) = 0 then              puppetSound(2, member(74, "Sfx"))            end if          end if      end case    end if    this.locH = Xpos    this.rotation = tiltAngle  end ifend
info.name: Whale
